scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic proof with independent finite exact-arithmetic supplementary checks. Same-model reviewed; no external independent audit and no claim of priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard integer lattice and Reeve tetrahedra in dimension three; no optimal covering-lattice conclusion. A related 2026 Reeve-construction paper was inspectable only by abstract, leaving historical priority provisional.
title: Exact lattice covering radius and torus coverage statistics of Reeve tetrahedra
